documents.title: Prosedur Penanganan Kendala Sinyal & Jaringan
documents.content:
Langkah penanganan awal jika sinyal hilang/lambat:
1. Minta pelanggan melakukan restart perangkat atau aktifkan Mode Pesawat (Flight Mode) selama 10 detik.
2. Pastikan lokasi pelanggan tidak dalam area perbaikan tower.
3. Cek sisa kuota data.
4. Jika kendala berlanjut lebih dari 1x24 jam, tawarkan pencatatan callback dari Tim Teknisi Lapangan menggunakan tool 'request_callback'.

documents.title: Set-Top Box Troubleshooting & Error Codes
Technical SOP

Common Set-Top Box Troubleshooting Steps:
1. Error Code 102 (Signal Lost / Black Screen):
   - Verify HDMI cable is firmly connected between the set-top box and TV set.
   - Unplug the power cable from the set-top box, wait 15 seconds, and plug it back in (Soft Reset).
   - Ensure TV input/source is set to HDMI 1 or HDMI 2.
2. Error Code 404 (Subscription Refresh Required):
   - Perform account signal refresh via account portal or request a technician callback.
3. If signal issue persists after reboot, log a technician callback using the 'request_callback' tool.
